plainTranslation: Composite Jupiter in the 4 House: With Composite Jupiter in the 4th house, you can feel more comfortable with each other emotionally, and help each other to feel better when you’re feeling insecure or upset. It can be easy to comfort one another, and you may understand each other better others. This can be an excellent position for a family relationship, and to build a family together as you enjoy doing so together and can build a solid foundation for your life together.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
note: Imported from The Dark Pixie Astrology composites material text.
